zh: 末元素能升到多高受两点限制：从 1 出发每一步最多升 1，而且每个值只能减小、不能增大。顺序可以任意重排，所以先想清楚应该怎样排列。
把数组升序排列后从左往右处理，维护当前位置能取到的最大值：它不能超过自己的原值，也不能比前一个位置大 1 以上。按这个贪心一路推进，最后位置的值就是答案。
排序；令当前值为 0；对每个值 v，把当前值更新为 v 与“当前值加 1”中的较小者；遍历结束输出当前值。由于 v≥1，首元素自然变成 1；单元素数组的答案是 1。
en: How high the last element can go is limited in two ways: starting from 1 it can rise by at most 1 per step, and each value can only be decreased, never increased. Since the order is free, first decide how the values should be arranged.

Sort the array in ascending order and process it from left to right, keeping the largest value the current position can take: it cannot exceed its own original value, and it cannot be more than 1 above the previous position. Pushing this greedy through gives the answer at the last position.

Sort; set the current value to 0; for each value v, set the current value to the smaller of v and the current value plus 1; after the loop, print the current value. Since v ≥ 1, the first element automatically becomes 1, and a single-element array gives 1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

After sorting, start from current=0 and update current=min(v,current+1) for each value v; the final current is the answer.

## Proof of correctness

A first element of 1 with each step rising by at most 1 gives a final value h≤n. For the sorted value a[i], for the final value to reach h>a[i], working backwards the last h−a[i] items must all be greater than a[i], but the original array has at most n−1−i items greater than a[i], so h≤a[i]+n−1−i. Unrolling the greedy recurrence shows the final value is exactly the minimum of n and all of these upper bounds; the construction never exceeds any original value, starts at 1, and has differences ≤1, so reaching this common upper bound makes it optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
